## Requirements

(From the contract — deliverables 1–5.)

1. `foreign/e3-typescript/` — `lib/` shared core (JCS canonical bytes,
   sha-256 via `node:crypto`, `idp_id`, `address_blob`, `identify_text`,
   tree/1 docs) + arm modules for identity trees, identity records,
   ledger transcript, registry snapshot, canonical-parse; `foreign.ts`
   driver writes `answers.json`. Erasable TS only; no npm deps.
2. `answers.json` for the covered arms + verbatim `hh-xcheck verify`
   output (per-arm counts) in README + this ledger; mismatches fixed or
   recorded as contract questions — never a patched answer.
3. README — toolchain (node version), run commands, per-arm notes,
   spec-text discrepancies, the `foreign-run-verified` evidence-class
   statement.
4. Runnable `scripts/xcheck-e3.sh` (node probe; absent →

5. Dated `foreign-run-verified` notes on DF-S1.5-3 + DF-S1.8-1 (DONE
   only if fully met — else state exactly what E2+E3 covers; rows stay
   OPEN for the extension arms).

## Plan

1. `foreign/e3-typescript/lib/core.ts` — `hh-json/1` canonical codec
   (byte-sorted keys, closed escape set, integers only, unpaired
   surrogates refused), `sha256Hex`, `idp_id`, `address_blob`,
   `identify_text` (`hir.text` verbatim — the E1 semantic; the
   `identify_text` spec-text defect is recorded, E2 precedent).
2. `lib/trees.ts` — manifest → Merkelized doc → `idp_id("tree", …)`;
   `lib/records.ts` — blob/text/record forms.
3. `lib/ledger.ts` — the `0x00 ‖ canonical(env−hash) ‖ prev` WAL fold.
4. `lib/registry.ts` — record/name/revocation/stale projections + the
   fixed corpus output vector (Audit resolves, six snapshot-pinned
   Execute selectors, `kind=variant` query, three `slot_choices`).
5. `lib/canonical_parse.ts` — frame parse + digest + timing members.
6. `foreign.ts` driver (`<bundle-dir> <answers.json>`;
   `candidate: "E3-candidate"`) + committed `answers.json`.
7. `scripts/xcheck-e3.sh` — node ≥ 22 probe → run → `hh-xcheck verify`;
   covered-arm FAILs exit 1, pending-arm "missing answer" FAILs are the
   recorded R4.4a scope; `skipped(node-absent)` exit 3.
8. `crates/hh-xcheck/tests/r4_4.rs` — committed-answers verify leg
   (hermetic), node replay leg (`skipped(node-absent)` honest), script
   skip leg.
9. README + DEFERRALS dated notes + closeout.
